findings_qualitative.value: CBD is resolved into two spiral arms connected to Source N and Source S; m=1 mode less obvious than in L1551 NE.

evidence.quote: The CBD is resolved into two spiral arms, one connecting to the CSD around the northern binary source, Source N, and the other to Source S.

claims.hypothesis: The CBD of L1551 IRS 5 resolves into spiral arms connected to the CSDs
claims.result: Two spiral arms (Arm N, Arm S); CBD radius ~150 au
claims.finding: The ringlike CBD seen at 1.3 mm is two spirals

evidence.quote: At $\sim$0.07$''$ (= 10 au) resolution in the 0.9 mm emission, two circumstellar disks (CSDs) associated with the binary protostars are separated from the circumbinary disk (CBD).

claims.hypothesis: Gas in the spiral arms shows expansion plus rotation caused by binary torques
claims.experiment: C18O and OCS P-V diagrams compared with simulation
claims.result: NE-blueshifted/SW-redshifted gradients along the minor axis reproduced by model
claims.finding: Expansion arises from non-axisymmetric gravitational torques

evidence.quote: These results indicate that the spiral arms have expanding motions, as well as rotation

claims.hypothesis: CBD-to-CSD transitions and L1 gas flow are identifiable
claims.experiment: Zoomed P-V diagrams near sources compared with Keplerian curves and model
claims.result: Velocity increase matches CSD Keplerian rotation; N-S gradient between sources at L1
claims.finding: Transitions occur near L2/L3; L1 stagnation flow

evidence.quote: The observed transitions from the CBD to the CSDs indeed appear to occur around the inferred L2 and L3 Lagrangian points

claims.hypothesis: L1551 IRS 5 is hotter than L1551 NE, consistent with an FU Ori event
claims.experiment: Brightness temperatures of continuum and lines compared with L1551 NE
claims.result: CSD >260 K and CBD gas >100 K versus 42 K and ~54 K in NE
claims.finding: Higher temperature likely reflects FU Ori event; may suppress m=1

evidence.quote: These results support the previous claim that L1551 IRS 5 is in the state of an FU Orionis event.

limitations_admitted.value: Model CBD larger than observed; magnetic field not included; high-velocity blueshifted components near Source N not reproduced; infall not identified observationally

evidence.quote: On the other hand, the model velocity channel maps do not reproduce the observed highly blueshifted components to the north and south of Source N.
